chunks: Neither was Abraham a Jew nor a Christian, but upright and obedient, and not an idolater.
ai.seo_question: What was the religion of Prophet Ibrahim according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes Ibrahim as the primordial archetype of pure monotheism (Tawhid), preceding the institutionalization of Judaism and Christianity. It highlights his status as a 'Hanif' who submitted exclusively to God, serving as the spiritual forefather for all true believers rather than adherents of later specific legal schools.
